comment:
* Reader that specializes in parsing {@code /proc/} files quickly. Walks * through the stream using a single space {@code ' '} as token separator, and * requires each line boundary to be explicitly acknowledged using * {@link #finishLine()}. Assumes {@link StandardCharsets#US_ASCII} encoding. *

* Currently doesn't support formats based on {@code \0}, tabs. * Consecutive spaces are treated as a single delimiter.

variables.name: mLineFinished
variables.comment: Flag when last read token finished current line.

methods.name: private int fillBuf() throws IOException
methods.comment: * Read more data from {@link #mStream} into internal buffer.

methods.name: private void consumeBuf(int count) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Consume number of bytes from beginning of internal buffer. If consuming
     * all remaining bytes, will attempt to {@link #fillBuf()}.

methods.name: private int nextTokenIndex() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Find buffer index of next token delimiter, usually space or newline.
     * Fills buffer as needed.
     *
     * @return Index of next delimeter, otherwise -1 if no tokens remain on
     *         current line.

methods.name: public boolean hasMoreData()
methods.comment: * Check if stream has more data to be parsed.

methods.name: public void finishLine() throws IOException
methods.comment: * Finish current line, skipping any remaining data.

methods.comment: * Parse and return next token as {@link String}.

methods.comment:
